summary: Agnes AI's official Model Pricing page lists agnes-2.5-flash and agnes-3.0-flash at a current price of $0 per million tokens for cached input, input and output (list prices $0.005/M cached input, $0.05/M input, $0.15/M output shown struck through), and states they are currently free. The free pricing is promotional; end dates are subject to Agnes AI platform announcements. The API is reached at https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1 with a Bearer API key created in the Agnes AI console. The official page does not say 'permanently free', nor confirm the 256K context figure from the lead.
claim_steps: Log in to the Agnes AI console and open the API Key management page
Create and copy an API key
Set the API base URL to https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1 and send requests with Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY using model agnes-2.5-flash or agnes-3.0-flash
